evidence.quote: On 93,123 half-semi lots, the detached house, house + suite and houseplex cards assume the attached half is removed. Today one of those can become the headline, and RD semis carry no disclosure saying so.

note: Recommendation: add a flag requires_attached_half_removed. Flagged rows never become the headline; they show as cards with a badge, and a new disclosure attached_half_removal applies in every zone including RD.

evidence.quote: The estimate uses the whole semi footprint for one half, so renovation figures and basement/addition costs are about 2× too high on ~53,000 halves.

note: Recommendation: use half the shared footprint as the estimate on a half-semi lot, disclosed as an estimate, until the owner enters their own.

evidence.quote: A secondary suite in a semi is deferred (M-214(3)), but suite add-ons can appear on the semi houseplex and semi renovation cards.

note: Recommendation: no suite add-on on semi houseplex or semi renovation cards; show the deferred disclosure instead.

key: Rear-suite CoA vs your earlier ruling LC-49

evidence.quote: You approved a CoA version of the rear suite today. LC-49 (Spec 131) says CoA does not apply to the rear suite.

note: Recommendation: amend LC-49 to allow it, but show it as not evaluated (coa_factor_unfitted) until there are enough realized CoA suites to calibrate it.

key: Same-form comparables vs your earlier ruling LC-51

evidence.quote: You approved comparables by build type. LC-51 says no new field for comparables.

note: Recommendation: no new stored field. Filter the existing comparable_builds list by build type when the report is assembled, so LC-51 still holds.

evidence.quote: Addition (back/up) already uses the renovation envelope. Expanding the envelope needs its own definition to be a separate card.

note: Recommendation: Addition = a targeted addition up or back sized by the owner; Expanding the envelope = keep the house and build out to the full renovation envelope (renovation_envelope_gfa_sqm − existing). Reject with a note if you meant something else.

key: Open the app contract (Spec 100) for report identity and media

evidence.quote: Spec 100 excludes zoning and geometry today. The report needs zone label, lot frontage/depth, the map outline, the Street View block and the offers list.

note: Recommendation: amend Spec 100 to whitelist these, server and mobile in one commit, with offers as a separate top-level list (never inside lot data).

evidence.quote: Spec 126 defines placements; Spec 128 makes the Sponsored label mandatory. No placement policy is set.

note: Recommendation: two slots: after the scenario cards (detail_footer, already declared) and in the renovation section (renovation contractors). Never inside a card. Always labelled Sponsored.

key: Street View photo for the renovation section

evidence.quote: Web builds a Street View URL on the client with a public key; mobile has none. Google terms allow caching the panorama id but not the image; cost is per image.

note: Recommendation: fetch on the server (find the panorama, aim it at the lot, sign the URL), cache only the panorama id, always show attribution, cap usage with a kill switch, never use the photo as data. Re-check Google current pricing and terms first.

Recommendation: v1 uses about 33 static illustrations keyed by scenario × roof form × suite type × semi, captioned Illustrative — not this lot. A per-lot massing drawing from the card numbers comes later.

evidence.quote: Today cost is per lot, not per scenario; no spec owns per-scenario cost.

note: Recommendation: the Spec 88 cost lane owns it: each scenario card prices its own floor area with the existing rates, after the scenario step exists.
